 The generated shell code is a thin capture adapter.
 It calls the internal hook boundary and does not construct history records itself.
 
-`histlog doctor` prints JSON diagnostics by default and supports a plain text mode:
+`histlog doctor` prints plain diagnostics by default and supports JSON for scripts:
 
 [source,sh]
 ----
 histlog doctor zsh
-histlog doctor zsh --plain
+histlog doctor zsh --json
 ----
 
 Bash integration uses the shell `DEBUG` trap.
